cells.gaps: No text of the National ICT Policy 2014 has been found, and no row gives its period, a delivery plan or a report against it; period is read as open because instruments.csv gives no end year. Its replacement, the National ICT Policy (draft of 2022), was last recorded in 2023 as awaiting Cabinet (UGA-010), with nothing dated since and no adoption on record. The governance rows (UGA-002, UGA-008, UGA-009, UGA-015, UGA-016) concern the draft or the National ICT Development Strategy and all fall before the 36-month window. UGA-004 (2025) speaks of an absence of strong national ICT policy frameworks, which disagrees with the adopted 2014 policy and is not a dated statement that none exists.
cells.note: National ICT Policy 2014: the newest adopted sector policy, listed in 2022 as in force and under review, not replaced. Stage 3 needs its text public and none has been found, so it stops at stage 2; the text held (UGA-013) is the 2022 draft's.
